Olga: FYI scheduling a Dedicated rollout for StarryHealth tonight 20:50 PT. Aim: pin runtime to v2026-03-1b, warm KV cache, run golden-prompt parity checks, and then progressive traffic shift. Need SRE + Ops ACK. @Mira @Dex
DeployBot: [deploybot] Rollout scheduled: starry-dedicated-vpin -> 2026-03-21T20:50:00-07:00. Canary plan: 10% (10m) -> 40% (10m) -> 100% (20m). RunID db-roll-1768888123. Preflight checks queued.
Mira: Can we add an explicit KV warm probe and a short sampling of golden prompts at each stage? last time warmup delayed and caused early p99 jitter.
Olga: Absolutely. Playbook additions: probe-kv at stage start, wait 90s post-warm before evaluating p99, golden-sample at 10% and 40% with size 30. Emergency rollback CLI included.
Dex: Rollback thresholds request: list them here so oncall has zero ambiguity.
Olga: Rollback triggers in runbook: (1) p99 >130ms above baseline for 3 consecutive 1m buckets, (2) error rate >1% sustained for 5m, (3) semantic-drift >1.8% on golden set. Auto-halt and revert on trigger; manual rollback requires two approvers.
Ben: KMS check: tenant rotation for Starry is scheduled in ~36h, so no immediate conflict. Ops still wants a temporary KMS hold step pre-final-promote.
Ops: We'll add `ops toggle-kms-hold --tenant starry --until 2026-03-23` in the flow. Owner assigned: ops@infra (Ben).
DeployBot: Preflight summary for db-roll-1768888123:
```
- capacity-check: reserved pool 1.2x -> OK
- config-validate: OK
- smoke-tests: 9/9 passed
- kv-probe: scheduled at canary start
- canary-policy: 10 -> 40 -> 100
```
Mira: Added probe commands to playbook: `redwoodctl probe-kv --tenant starry --samples 100` and golden eval: `redwoodctl eval --tenant starry --golden 30`. Also noted 90s settle between stage end and p99 checks.
Dex: I updated emergency rollback snippet to include force drain and run-id: ```redwoodctl rollback --tenant starry --to-version v2026-02.x --force --run-id db-roll-1768888123``` Added to runbook.
Olga: Final GO/NO-GO cutoff at 20:35 PT. Please ack here. Post-roll collect: prefix-hit timeline, KV warm curve, and p50/p95/p99 at 30s resolution for first 10m.
Mira: GO from SRE. I'll monitor p99, cache hit-rate, and golden diffs.
Ben: GO from Ops. I'll be on the keyboard for KMS hold toggle and any emergency actions.
Dex: GO. Oncall ready.
Olga: Thanks. DeployBot proceed as scheduled and auto-halt on triggers. Reopen this thread if anything changes. :white_check_mark:
